title: Implement the complete physical Gaussian tensor transform
body:
I connect the retained Gaussian expansion, complete chirp and principal-core compression into a physical source-box transform. The isolated `research/physical-gaussian-tensor/` package includes actual coefficient production, four canonical full-support gathers/scatters, short-field moves, periodic halos, page reuse, source-core assembly and exact normalization restoration.

The conditional proof derives the `R F_s` error bound with `D=d-1` and `gamma=D(2u+ceilLog2(32p)+1)`. It charges the complete catalogue, spectators, metadata, numerical children and polynomial setup, retaining the existing `.99827619697` transfer allowance. I state the required caller growth laws and preserve the selected frontier.

I checked both explicit p48/P80 directions against separate natural-coordinate staged references:49 inputs,64 middle coordinates and49 outputs, with all4900 output bits equal and12 nonzero restored outputs in each direction. I also check altered-axis and half-disk rejection, positive reuse, protected outputs and fixed scratch restoration. The registered producer regenerates all113537 coefficient cells before the consumers use the authenticated immutable return.

Verification: metadata,52 committed package/input files, source history and official-export integrity pass at `688e9c45432db8b6ff9847f096bbf7e4b7693c00`. All six registered commands passed from the official Git-free export, including fresh coefficient regeneration and both full consumers; all53 files including the receipt kept their bytes and modes. Export SHA256: `82d24bbd896a74375b4fd688158b449ed8b3929fdfd556280e131e58317e51b4`; receipt SHA256: `a423dae06da7a80d361397cf4ca2445d43ceacf0abebc4e7940bdb0d35797f2f`. Declared timeouts total1200 seconds, with a390-second maximum command. Hosted confirmation remains pending. [Discussion3664](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3664) records coordination, failures, evidence levels and publication receipts.

The finite witness uses reduced Gaussian halos and retained q2 literal children. I do not use its repeated7×7 source lengths as a pairwise-coprime CRT witness. Production-sized execution, inherited universal supplier premises, CRT/integer recovery and independent human or formal-kernel review remain open. `ARITHMETIC.md` discloses the exact byte-control, small-order radical and guarded scalar adaptations; `CATALOGUE.md` records the generated page's provenance and invalidation.

Jose Manuel (`jmbarrancoml`), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. I retain the complete source exports and attribution from PR3878/3851/3787/3763/3709/3640, Dugongue's PR3877, the RaD project/hipotures and the nested notices. PR3910's local norm audit and PR3926's residue-size result remain separate contributions.
